title: Glass Shelf 16-Inch Double Shelf with Towel Bar, Solid Brass Wall Mount | Waverly Place | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your bath storage with a wall-mounted glass shelf that adds two display levels plus an integrated towel bar, crafted with 3/8-inch thick tempered glass and solid brass hardware from the waverly place collection.

  • Double glass shelf: two tiers for organizing everyday essentials
  • Tempered glass: 3/8-inch (0.38-inch) thick for safety and strength
  • Gallery rail: solid brass rail helps keep items secure
  • Integrated towel bar: keeps towels within reach
  • Clean install: concealed screw mounting hardware

Specs

  • Collection: Waverly Place (matching waverly place)
  • Category: Glass Shelves
  • Style: Traditional
  • Mounting type: Wall mount
  • Dimensions: 16-Inch length x 12-Inch height x 5-Inch width; 5-Inch projection
  • Glass thickness: 0.38 inch
  • Weight capacity: 4 lb
  • Included: Glass shelf and all installation hardware
  • Assembly required: No
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
  • Finishes: Available in 28 designer finishes, including statement finishes such as pink, antique pewter, mediterranean blue, lavender, and golden yellow

Designed to coordinate across transitional bath accessories, this piece helps you build a cohesive look with distinctive finish options.

_previous.title: 16 Inch Gallery Double Glass Shelf with Towel Bar
_previous.description: Add a flare of style to your décor with this decorative glass shelf. Shelf can be used anywhere in the home for a great space to store your products. Gallery rail will keep your items secure while the integrated towel bar provides a creative space for your towels. Tempered glass is 3/8 Inches thick and all of the hardware is made of solid brass and finished with the highest quality materials to provide a lifetime of beauty.
